input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The only pricing-parity undertaking in the Agreement runs in our favour: TrueLink (Vendor) commits that Hosting Services rates will not exceed those charged to any other party, plus a one-year price freeze. A review of the Compensation section (sec-5), the Client covenants (sec-8) and full-text searches for MFN language ("most favored", "favorable", "no less favorable", "best", "terms offered", "any other party") found no obligation on Mortgage Logic.com (Client) to extend TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers. Consistent with the rule, a Vendor-granted MFN is welcome and no redline is proposed.
